sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Real Estate anchor market strength as all-green leaders, while Financials and Real Estate gain ground against slipping Industrials and Materials.

Defensive and hard-asset sectors are showing robust breadth in the current environment. Only 3 of 11 groups are "all-green" (positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD timeframes): Energy (momentum 0.90), Real Estate (momentum 0.72), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.43). Real Estate is also rotating higher, gaining 1 spot to reach Rank 3, alongside Financials (Rank 7, momentum 0.62) and Communication Services (Rank 9, momentum 0.50), which both improved by 1 spot over the last five sessions.

On the downside, cyclical and commodity-linked groups are fading. Basic Materials slipped 1 spot to Rank 8 with weak momentum of 0.20, and Industrials fell 1 spot to Rank 4 with a momentum score of 0.35. Healthcare also dropped 1 spot to Rank 10 despite holding a moderate momentum score of 0.50. Consumer Cyclical remains anchored at the bottom of the pack, ranking 11th with a weak momentum score of 0.18.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 out of 11 sectors—Energy, Real Estate, and Consumer Defensive—are currently "all-green" with positive performance across all timeframes.
* **Energy Dominance:** Energy remains the top-performing sector (YTD Rank 1) with a commanding momentum score of 0.90.
* **Real Estate & Defensive Support:** Real Estate (momentum 0.72, Rank 3) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.43, Rank 5) round out the all-green leadership, showing steady performance across short- and long-term horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Upward Rotations:** Communication Services (+1 spot to Rank 9, momentum 0.50), Financials (+1 spot to Rank 7, momentum 0.62), and Real Estate (+1 spot to Rank 3) led the weekly gainers.
* **Slipping Sectors:** Industrials (Rank 4, momentum 0.35), Basic Materials (Rank 8, momentum 0.20), and Healthcare (Rank 10, momentum 0.50) each shed 1 spot over the last five sessions.
* **Momentum Extremes:** Energy (0.90) and Real Estate (0.72) lead the momentum rankings, while Consumer Cyclical (0.18) and Basic Materials (0.20) lag furthest behind.

## Divergences
* **Healthcare Rank vs. Momentum:** Healthcare sits near the bottom at Rank 10 YTD, but holds a moderate momentum score of 0.50, suggesting its underlying trend is stronger than its relative rank implies.
* **Industrials Momentum Decay:** Industrials maintains a high YTD rank of 4, but its momentum has faded to 0.35, signaling potential downside risk as it slipped 1 spot this week.
* **No Fragile All-Greens:** There are no active early-warning divergences or fragile trends flagged among the all-green leadership group (Energy, Real Estate, and Consumer Defensive).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy refining and transport logistics lead a highly concentrated market, while industrial commodities like aluminum and uranium suffer sharp weekly declines.

Market leadership remains tightly clustered, with only 16.7% (24 of 144) of industry groups achieving all-green status across all time horizons. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing dominates the momentum landscape, supported by transportation segments like Railroads and Trucking, alongside REIT - Healthcare Facilities. 

Rotation is visible in consumer-facing and niche sectors, with Shell Companies and Apparel Retail posting strong weekly rank gains. Conversely, commodity and defensive areas like Aluminum and Education & Training Services are fading rapidly, joining long-term laggards like IT Services at the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Strength
* **Concentrated Breadth:** Just 24 of 144 industry groups are all-green across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD frames, highlighting a highly selective market environment.
* **Refining and Logistics Lead:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads all groups with a momentum score of 0.990, while Railroads (0.879) and Trucking (0.868) show sustained, multi-month strength.
* **Defensive Real Estate:** REIT - Healthcare Facilities remains a top anchor, holding a 0.915 momentum score and a sustained top-36 ranking across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Shell Companies surged +22 spots to rank 75 (momentum 0.41), while Staffing & Employment Services jumped +15 spots to rank 15 with a strong 0.85 momentum. Apparel Retail also gained +15 spots to rank 80.
* **Sharp Decliners:** Aluminum plummeted -26 spots to rank 96 (momentum 0.24), and Education & Training Services dropped -24 spots to rank 90 (momentum 0.28).
* **Momentum Laggards:** Information Technology Services sits at the bottom of the market (momentum 0.029, rank_ytd 144), alongside Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.076) and Uranium (momentum 0.122).

## Divergences
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Shell Companies (+22 spots, momentum 0.41) and Recreational Vehicles (+12 spots, momentum 0.50) are jumping in rank despite currently low-to-moderate momentum scores.
* **Fading Leaders:** Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.73) and Food Distribution (momentum 0.62) are showing early signs of fatigue, slipping -7 and -8 spots respectively over the past 5 sessions.
